section.31: The Book of Manumission of Slaves

31.name_native: The Book of Manumission of Slaves

hadiths.text: Narrated AbuHurayrah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: The child of adultery is worst of the three. Abu Hurairah said: That I give a flog in the path of Allah (as a charity) is dearer to me than emancipating a child of adultery
